# F200 positive-cap save transition

The exact earlier structured-V3 representative uses published `4.4.20000` (SHA256 `29D85A53ABC69A6B3FDC0E4EA58C77FC9B53E5671B84441192AEE5E65A4CFBD4`) with `f200/v3-440-source` fixture0.9. Its byte-verified cap writer declares policy3; no source save is inferred from that fact. The [published selection](../../profiles/v3-440-cap-published-f200-2077.json) must earn two actual gear labs, observe owned cap2 disablement, then retain27% suspended work and a disabled foreign gear with42% unrelated queued work through save and two cold reloads. Reuse that protected save for the separate [F200](../../profiles/v3-440-cap-current0822-f200-2077.json) fixture0.10 and [F210](../../profiles/v3-440-cap-current1246-f210-2123.json) fixture0.11 successors. Each retains the strict source tuple, independent row/effect preflight and one real successor lab/save/two reloads. Compose each thin role's three files with the corresponding existing shared control, data-final and settings files, as for the4.7.3 roles below. These are prepared inputs, not native passes; worker-tail, label-collision and enabled-above-cap cases remain separate.

The separate `f200/same-from-473` 0.8.0 successor consumes the protected published4.7.20003/0.4.0 source directly on Factorio2.0.77. Keep the historical0.2.0 successor restricted to its original4.7.20002/0.1.0 source; using81AF with0.2.0 is an input mismatch, not a player defect. The [current0822 selection](../../profiles/f200-legacy-cap-473-current0822-f200-2077.json) pins the same-engine candidate and observer, requires preserved level3/.02/.27 and foreign-disabled42% queue, then one real successor lab/save/two cold reloads. Compose `info.json`, `control.lua` and `data-final-fixes.lua` from `f200/same-from-473`, `settings-updates.lua` from `successor`, and the shared successor control/data as `fixture_control.lua`/`fixture_data_final.lua`. Retain the original source bytes; no source recreation or historical guard relaxation is needed. Preparation and host controls alone do not qualify this native route.

Run the published profile with MIR 4.7.20002, then the successor profile with MIR 5.0.20000 and that exact saved world. Both use Factorio 2.0.77, Base and the active-mod observer. No overhaul resets research during the transition.

The published arm must earn two actual gear levels in a powered lab and observe MIR's cap disablement and the visibility already set by published cap presentation. Only then does it seed 27% suspended work. The successor must restore the owned presentation before queuing one more real lab completion. Restoration retains the published controller's captured true visibility value. Both arms preserve a separately disabled foreign gear technology and its unrelated 42% research queue, save, and cold-reload twice.

Count and time alone are accelerated after an independent complete-row preflight. This fixture does not qualify ordinary balance, physical gear production, native worker caps, multiplayer or the final release package.

The dedicated `f200/cross-to-f210` source uses exact published MIR 4.7.20003 on F200 Base 2.0.77, then hands its protected save to the separate `f210/cross-from-f200` MIR5 5.0.21000 Base 2.1.23 successor. It retains the same two source labs, cap 2-to-40 relaxation, 27% player work, disabled foreign gear and 42% foreign queue before one successor gear lab and two successor cold reloads. The native stager composes each thin cross-stage wrapper with the retained stage control as `fixture_control.lua` and retained stage data-final guard as `fixture_data_final.lua`; this is a finite explicit alias, not a player-source import. The source profile binds published archive `more-infinite-research_4.7.20003.zip` SHA256 `FBBA844DD04011A12BB6DA885745B0733AD37FAB181EAAD9EE4346B9B0D32647`. EA41 binds the F210 selections below as frozen inputs; source-save hashes and native runs still await native creation and are not guessed.

The separate `f210/disabled-after-f200` 0.6.0 stage records the EA41 F210 candidate settings while the owned gear family remains disabled. Its prepared profile is `f200-legacy-cap-cross-disabled-f210-mir5-2123.json`; it consumes the immutable source save only after native creation supplies its hash, retains the protected F200 level-three, 2% and 27% state plus the unchanged disabled foreign 42% queue, performs zero disabled-stage labs, saves, and cold-reloads twice. Only `f210/reenabled-after-f200` 0.7.0 may follow that explicit disabled save: `f200-legacy-cap-cross-reenabled-f210-mir5-2123.json` retains the same EA41 F210/observer closure, restores only owned gear, preserves the 27% work and disabled foreign queue, completes one re-enabled-stage lab, saves, and cold-reloads twice. This is the explicit source-save to disabled-save to re-enabled-save flow. The profiles are prepared inputs, not native passes or current-release claims; the intermediate does not qualify normal researchability, migration generally, balance, or multiplayer.
